outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, elective cesarean, emergency cesarean)
cohort: The study included 9305 women who delivered at a hospital in Karachi, Pakistan, between February 2017 and January 2018, stratified by their hepatitis B carrier status.
finding: While most antenatal and perinatal outcomes showed no significant difference between HBsAg carriers and non-carriers, hepatitis B carriers had a slightly increased risk of preterm delivery.
mod_finding: No significant difference was observed in the mode of delivery (vaginal, elective cesarean, emergency cesarean) between HBsAg carriers and non-carriers.
